title: Diameter of Binary Tree
summary: Find the number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes of a binary tree.

tests.explain: Two nodes joined by one edge.
The longest path, 7 → 5 → 3 → 2 → 4 → 6 → 8, bends at node 2 and never touches the root: 6 edges.

hints: Every path has one highest node where it bends. If the longest path bends at node X, how long is it in terms of X's subtrees?
Through X, the longest path has height(X.left) + height(X.right) edges, where height counts the nodes on the longest downward path.
Compute heights in one post-order pass. At each node, update an outer best with left + right, then return 1 + Math.max(left, right) to the parent.
